The '''Three Allied Kingdoms''' were a collection of affiliated states located within the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]]. It consisted of the three kingdoms of [[Kingdom of Jaminere|Jaminere]], [[Kingdom of Cadinth|Cadinth]], and [[Kingdom of Barseg|Barseg]] located along the [[Cadinth Run]] and other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Arcan IV]], [[Corlax 4]], and [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII]] waged a campaign against the Three Allied Kingdoms between [[25,150 BBY]] and [[25,130 BBY]], conquering those worlds and integrating them in [[Kingdom of Cron|Xer's Empire]].
